42000.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlStart
42000.description: The start time for commodity settlement where delivery occurs over time. The time format is specified by the settlement time type.

42001.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlEnd
42001.description: The end time for commodity settlement where delivery occurs over time. The time format is specified by the settlement time type.

42002.name: NoUnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriods
42002.description: Number of commodity settlement periods in the repeating group.

42003.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlCountry
42003.description: Specifies the country where delivery takes place. Uses ISO 3166 2-character country code.

42004.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlTimeZone
42004.description:
Commodity delivery timezone specified as "prevailing" rather than "standard" or "daylight".
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/prevailing-timezones for code list of applicable prevailing timezones.

42005.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlFlowType
42005.description: Specifies the commodity delivery flow type.

42006.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriodNotional
42006.description: Specifies the delivery quantity associated with this settlement period.

42007.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriodNotionalUnitOfMeasure
42007.description: Specifies the unit of measure (UOM) of the delivery quantity associated with this settlement period.

values.meaning: Principal with relation to debt instrument

42008.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriodFrequencyPeriod
42008.description: Time unit multiplier for the settlement period frequency.

42009.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriodFrequencyUnit
42009.description: Time unit associated with the settlement period frequency.

42011.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriodPriceUnitOfMeasure
42011.description: Specifies the settlement period price unit of measure (UOM).

values.meaning: Principal with relation to debt instrument

42012.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriodPriceCurrency
42012.description: The currency of the settlement period price. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

42013.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlHolidaysProcessingInstruction
42013.description: Indicates whether holidays are included in the settlement periods. Required for electricity contracts.

42014.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriodXID
42014.description: Identifier of this settlement period for cross referencing elsewhere in the message.

42015.name: UnderlyingStreamCommoditySettlPeriodXIDRef
42015.description: Cross reference to another settlement period for duplicating its properties.

42016.name: UnderlyingStreamXID
42016.description: Identifier of this UnderlyingStream for cross referencing elsewhere in the message.

42018.name: UnderlyingStreamNotionalXIDRef
42018.description: Cross reference to another UnderlyingStream notional for duplicating its properties.

42019.name: UnderlyingStreamNotionalFrequencyPeriod
42019.description: Time unit multiplier for the swap stream's notional frequency.

42020.name: UnderlyingStreamNotionalFrequencyUnit
42020.description: Time unit associated with the swap stream's notional frequency.

42021.name: UnderlyingStreamNotionalCommodityFrequency
42021.description: The commodity's notional or quantity delivery frequency.

42022.name: UnderlyingStreamNotionalUnitOfMeasure
42022.description: Specifies the delivery quantity unit of measure (UOM).

values.meaning: Principal with relation to debt instrument

42023.name: UnderlyingStreamTotalNotional
42023.description: Specifies the total notional or delivery quantity over the term of the contract.

42024.name: UnderlyingStreamTotalNotionalUnitOfMeasure
42024.description: Specifies the unit of measure (UOM) for the total notional or delivery quantity over the term of the contract.

values.meaning: Principal with relation to debt instrument

42025.name: EncodedUnderlyingAdditionalTermBondIssuerLen
42025.description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedUnderlyingAdditionalTermBondIssuer(42026) field.

42026.name: EncodedUnderlyingAdditionalTermBondIssuer
42026.description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondIssuer(42017) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondIssuer(42017) field.

42027.name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondSeniority
42027.description: Specifies the bond's payment priority in the event of a default.

42029.name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondCouponRate
42029.description: Coupon rate of the bond. See also CouponRate(223).

42030.name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondMaturityDate
42030.description: The maturity date of the bond.

42031.name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondParValue
42031.description: The par value of the bond.

42032.name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondCurrentTotalIssuedAmount
42032.description: Total issued amount of the bond.

42033.name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondCouponFrequencyPeriod
42033.description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

42034.name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondCouponFrequencyUnit
42034.description: Time unit associated with the frequency of the bond's coupon payment.

42035.name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermBondDayCount
42035.description: The day count convention used in interest calculations for a bond or an interest bearing security.

42036.name: NoUnderlyingAdditionalTerms
42036.description: Number of additional terms in the repeating group.

42037.name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermConditionPrecedentBondIndicator
42037.description: Indicates whether the condition precedent bond is applicable. The swap contract is only valid if the bond is issued and if there is any dispute over the terms of fixed stream then the bond terms would be used.

42038.name: UnderlyingAdditionalTermDiscrepancyClauseIndicator
42038.description: Indicates whether the discrepancy clause is applicable.

42039.name: NoUnderlyingCashSettlDealers
42039.description: Number of dealers in the repeating group.

42040.name: UnderlyingCashSettlDealer
42040.description: Identifies the dealer from whom price quotations for the reference obligation are obtained for the purpose of cash settlement valuation calculation.

42041.name: NoUnderlyingCashSettlTerms
42041.description: Number of elements in the repeating group.

42042.name: UnderlyingCashSettlCurrency
42042.description: Specifies the currency the UnderlyingCashSettlAmount(42054) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

42043.name: UnderlyingCashSettlValuationFirstBusinessDayOffset
42043.description: The number of business days after settlement conditions have been satisfied, when the calculation agent is to obtain a price quotation on the reference obligation for purposes of cash settlement.

42044.name: UnderlyingCashSettlValuationSubsequentBusinessDaysOffset
42044.description: The number of business days between successive valuation dates when multiple valuation dates are applicable for cash settlement.

42045.name: UnderlyingCashSettlNumOfValuationDates
42045.description: Where multiple valuation dates are specified as being applicable for cash settlement, this element specifies the number of applicable valuation dates.

42047.name: UnderlyingCashSettlBusinessCenter
42047.description:
Identifies the business center calendar used at valuation time for cash settlement purposes e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

42048.name: UnderlyingCashSettlQuoteMethod
42048.description: The type of quote used to determine the cash settlement price.

42049.name: UnderlyingCashSettlQuoteAmount
42049.description: When determining the cash settlement amount, if weighted average price quotes are to be obtained for the reference obligation, this is the upper limit to the outstanding principal balance of the reference obligation for which the quote should be obtained. If not specified, the ISDA definitions provide for a fallback amount equal to floating rate payer calculation amount.

42050.name: UnderlyingCashSettlQuoteCurrency
42050.description: Specifies the currency the UnderlyingCashSettlQuoteAmount(42049) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

42051.name: UnderlyingCashSettlMinimumQuoteAmount
42051.description: When determining the cash settlement amount, if weighted average price quotes are to be obtained for the reference obligation, this is the minimum intended threshold amount of outstanding principal balance of the reference obligation for which the quote should be obtained. If not specified, the ISDA definitions provide for a fallback amount of the lower of either USD1,000,000 (or its equivalent in the relevant obligation currency) or the (minimum) quoted amount.

42052.name: UnderlyingCashSettlMinimumQuoteCurrency
42052.description: Specifies the currency the UnderlyingCashSettlQuoteAmount(42049) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

42053.name: UnderlyingCashSettlBusinessDays
42053.description: The number of business days used in the determination of the cash settlement payment date.

42054.name: UnderlyingCashSettlAmount
42054.description: The amount paid between the trade parties, seller to the buyer, for cash settlement on the cash settlement date.

42055.name: UnderlyingCashSettlRecoveryFactor
42055.description: Used for fixed recovery, this specifies the recovery level as determined at contract inception, to be applied in the event of a default. The factor is used to calculate the amount paid by the seller to the buyer for cash settlement on the cash settlement date. The amount is calculated is (1 - UnderlyingCashSettlRecoveryFactor(42055)) x floating rate payer calculation amount. The currency is derived from the floating rate payer calculation amount.

42056.name: UnderlyingCashSettlFixedTermIndicator
42056.description: Indicates whether fixed settlement is applicable or not applicable in a recovery lock.

42057.name: UnderlyingCashSettlAccruedInterestIndicator
42057.description: Indicates whether accrued interest is included or not in the value provided in UnderlyingCashSettlAmount(42054).

42058.name: UnderlyingCashSettlValuationMethod
42058.description: The ISDA defined methodology for determining the final price of the reference obligation for purposes of cash settlement.

42060.name: NoUnderlyingPhysicalSettlTerms
42060.description: Number of entries in the repeating group.

42061.name: UnderlyingPhysicalSettlCurrency
42061.description: Currency of physical settlement. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

42062.name: UnderlyingPhysicalSettlBusinessDays
42062.description: A number of business days. Its precise meaning is dependent on the context in which this element is used.

42063.name: UnderlyingPhysicalSettlMaximumBusinessDays
42063.description: A maximum number of business days. Its precise meaning is dependent on the context in which this element is used. Intended to be used to limit a particular ISDA fallback provision.

42064.name: UnderlyingPhysicalSettlTermXID
42064.description: A named string value referenced by UnderlyingSettlTermXIDRef(41315).

42065.name: NoUnderlyingPhysicalSettlDeliverableObligations
42065.description: Number of entries in the repeating group.

42066.name: UnderlyingPhysicalSettlDeliverableObligationType
42066.description:
Specifies the type of delivery obligation applicable for physical settlement.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/deliverable-obligation-type for code list for applicable deliverable obligation types.

42067.name: UnderlyingPhysicalSettlDeliverableObligationValue
42067.description:
Physical settlement delivery obligation value appropriate to UnderlyingPhysicalSettlDeliverableObligationType(42066).
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/deliverable-obligation-type for applicable obligation type values.

42068.name: NoUnderlyingProtectionTerms
42068.description: Number of protection terms in the repeating group.

42069.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermNotional
42069.description: The notional amount of protection coverage for a floating rate.

42070.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermCurrency
42070.description: The currency of UnderlyingProtectionTermNotional(42069). Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

42071.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermSellerNotifies
42071.description: The notifying party is the party that notifies the other party when a credit event has occurred by means of a credit event notice. If more than one party is referenced as being the notifying party then either party may notify the other of a credit event occurring.

42072.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermBuyerNotifies
42072.description: The notifying party is the party that notifies the other party when a credit event has occurred by means of a credit event notice. If more than one party is referenced as being the notifying party then either party may notify the other of a credit event occurring.

42073.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventBusinessCenter
42073.description:
When used, the business center indicates the local time of the business center that replaces the Greenwich Mean Time in Section 3.3 of the 2003 ISDA Credit Derivatives Definitions.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

42074.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermStandardSources
42074.description: Indicates whether ISDA defined Standard Public Sources are applicable (UnderlyingProtectionTermStandardSources(42074)=Y) or not.

42075.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventMinimumSources
42075.description: The minimum number of the specified public information sources that must publish information that reasonably confirms that a credit event has occurred. The market convention is two.

42076.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermXID
42076.description: A named string value referenced by UnderlyingProtectionTermXIDRef(41314).

42077.name: NoUnderlyingProtectionTermEvents
42077.description: Number of protection term events in the repeating group.

42078.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventType
42078.description:
Specifies the type of credit event applicable to the protection terms.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/protection-term-event-type for code list of applicable event types.

42079.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventValue
42079.description:
Protection term event value appropriate to UnderlyingProtectionTermEventType(42078).
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/protection-term-event-type for applicable event type values.

42080.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventCurrency
42080.description: Applicable currency if UnderlyingProtectionTermEventValue(42079) is an amount. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

42081.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventPeriod
42081.description: Time unit multiplier for protection term events.

42082.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventUnit
42082.description: Time unit associated with protection term events.

42083.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventDayType
42083.description: Day type for events that specify a period and unit.

42084.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventRateSource
42084.description: Rate source for events that specify a rate source, e.g. Floating rate interest shortfall.

42085.name: NoUnderlyingProtectionTermEventQualifiers
42085.description: Number of qualifiers in the repeating group.

42086.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventQualifier
42086.description: Protection term event qualifier. Used to further qualify UnderlyingProtectionTermEventType(43078).

42087.name: NoUnderlyingProtectionTermObligations
42087.description: Number of obligations in the repeating group.

42088.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermObligationType
42088.description:
Specifies the type of obligation applicable to the protection terms.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/protection-term-obligation-type for code list of applicable obligation types.

42089.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermObligationValue
42089.description:
Protection term obligation value appropriate to UnderlyingProtectionTermObligationType(42088).
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/protection-term-obligation-type for applicable obligation type values.

42090.name: NoUnderlyingProtectionTermEventNewsSources
42090.description: Number of event news sources in the repeating group.

42091.name: UnderlyingProtectionTermEventNewsSource
42091.description: Newspaper or electronic news service or source that may publish relevant information used in the determination of whether or not a credit event has occurred.

42092.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateBusinessDayConvention
42092.description: The business day convention used to adjust the provisional cash settlement payment's termination, or relative termination, date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

42093.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateRelativeTo
42093.description:
Specifies the anchor date when the cash settlement payment date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

42094.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateOffsetPeriod
42094.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative cash settlement payment date offset.

42095.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateOffsetUnit
42095.description: Time unit associated with the relative cash settlement payment date offset.

42096.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateOffsetDayType
42096.description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative cash settlement payment date offset.

42097.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateRangeFirst
42097.description: First date in range when a settlement date range is provided.

42098.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateRangeLast
42098.description: Last date in range when a settlement date range is provided.

42099.name: NoUnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDates
42099.description: Number of UnderlyingProvision cash settlement payment dates in the repeating group.

42100.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDate
42100.description: The cash settlement payment date, unadjusted or adjusted depending on UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateType(42101).

42101.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlPaymentDateType
42101.description: Specifies the type of date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

42102.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlQuoteSource
42102.description: Identifies the source of quote information.

42103.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlQuoteReferencePage
42103.description: Identifies the reference "page" from the quote source.

42104.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueTime
42104.description: A time specified in 24-hour format, e.g. 11am would be represented as 11:00:00. The time of the cash settlement valuation date when the cash settlement amount will be determined according to the cash settlement method if the parties have not otherwise been able to agree to the cash settlement amount.

42105.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueTimeBusinessCenter
42105.description:
Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's cash settlement valuation time.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

42106.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueDateBusinessDayConvention
42106.description: The business day convention used to adjust the cash settlement valuation date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

42107.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueDateRelativeTo
42107.description:
Specifies the anchor date when the cash settlement value date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

42108.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueDateOffsetPeriod
42108.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative cash settlement value date offset.

42109.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueDateOffsetUnit
42109.description: Time unit associated with the relative cash settlement value date offset.

42110.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueDateOffsetDayType
42110.description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative cash settlement value date offset.

42111.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlValueDateAdjusted
42111.description: The adjusted cash settlement value date.

42112.name: NoUnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDates
42112.description: Number of UnderlyingProvision option exercise fixed dates in the repeating group.

42113.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDate
42113.description: A predetermined option exercise date, unadjusted or adjusted depending on UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDateType(42114).

42114.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseFixedDateType
42114.description: Specifies the type of date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

42115.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseBusinessDayConvention
42115.description: The business day convention used to adjust the underlying instrument's provision's option exercise date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

42116.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetPeriod
42116.description: Time unit multiplier for the interval to the first (and possibly only) exercise date in the exercise period.

42117.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetUnit
42117.description: Time unit associated with the interval to the first (and possibly only) exercise date in the exercise period.

42118.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseFrequencyPeriod
42118.description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of subsequent exercise dates in the exercise period following the earliest exercise date. An interval of 1 day should be used to indicate an American style exercise frequency.

42119.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseFrequencyUnit
42119.description: Time unit associated with the frequency of subsequent exercise dates in the exercise period following the earliest exercise date.

42120.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateUnadjusted
42120.description: The unadjusted first day of the exercise period for an American style option.

42121.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateRelativeTo
42121.description:
Specifies the anchor date when the option exercise start date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

42122.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetPeriod
42122.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative option exercise start date offset.

42123.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetUnit
42123.description: Time unit associated with the relative option exercise start date offset.

42124.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetDayType
42124.description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option exercise start date offset.

42125.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseStartDateAdjusted
42125.description: The adjusted first day of the exercise period for an American style option.

42126.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExercisePeriodSkip
42126.description: The number of periods in the referenced date schedule that are between each date in the relative date schedule. Thus a skip of 2 would mean that dates are relative to every second date in the referenced schedule. If present this should have a value greater than 1.

42127.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseBoundsFirstDateUnadjusted
42127.description: The unadjusted first date of a schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of exercise dates when they are relative.

42128.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseBoundsLastDateUnadjusted
42128.description: The unadjusted last date of a schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of exercise dates when they are relative.

42129.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestTime
42129.description: The earliest time at which notice of exercise can be given by the buyer to the seller (or seller's agent) i) on the expriation date, in the case of a European style option, (ii) on each bermuda option exercise date and the expiration date, in the case of a Bermuda style option the commencement date to, and including, the expiration date, in the case of an American option.

42130.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseEarliestTimeBusinessCenter
42130.description:
Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's earliest time for notice of exercise.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

42131.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseLatestTime
42131.description: For a Bermuda or American style option, the latest time on an exercise business day (excluding the expiration date) within the exercise period that notice can be given by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent. Notice of exercise given after this time will be deemed to have been given on the next exercise business day.

42132.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseLatestTimeBusinessCenter
42132.description:
Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's latest time for notice of exercise.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

42133.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationDateUnadjusted
42133.description: The unadjusted last day within an exercise period for an American style option. For a European style option it is the only day within the exercise period.

42134.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationDateBusinessDayConvention
42134.description: The business day convention used to adjust the underlying instrument's provision's option expiration date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

42135.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationDateRelativeTo
42135.description:
Specifies the anchor date when the option expiration date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

42136.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationDateOffsetPeriod
42136.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative option expiration date offset.

42137.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationDateOffsetUnit
42137.description: Time unit associated with the relative option expiration date offset.

42138.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationDateOffsetDayType
42138.description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option expiration date offset.

42139.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationDateAdjusted
42139.description: The adjusted last date within an exercise period for an American style option. For a European style option it is the only date within the exercise period.

42140.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationTime
42140.description: The latest time for exercise on the expiration date.

42141.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExpirationTimeBusinessCenter
42141.description:
Identifies the business center calendar used with the provision's latest exercise time on expiration date.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

42142.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateUnadjusted
42142.description: The unadjusted date on the underlying set by the exercise of an option. What this date is depends on the option (e.g. in a swaption it is the swap effective date, in an extendible/cancelable provision it is the swap termination date).

42143.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateBizDayConvention
42143.description: The business day convnetion used to adjust the underlying instrument provision's option underlying date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

42144.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateRelativeTo
42144.description:
Specifies the anchor date when the date relevant to the underlying trade on exercise is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

42145.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateOffsetPeriod
42145.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative option relevant underlying date offset.

42146.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateOffsetUnit
42146.description: Time unit associated with the relative option relevant underlying date offset.

42147.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateOffsetDayType
42147.description: Specifies the day type of the provision's relative option relevant underlying date offset.

42148.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionRelevantUnderlyingDateAdjusted
42148.description: The adjusted date on the underlying set by the exercise of an option. What this date is depends on the option (e.g. in a swaption it is the swap effective date, in an extendible/cancelable provision it is the swap termination date).

42149.name: NoUnderlyingProvisions
42149.description: Number of provisions in the repeating group.

42151.name: UnderlyingProvisionDateUnadjusted
42151.description: The unadjusted date of the provision.

42152.name: UnderlyingProvisionDateBusinessDayConvention
42152.description: The business day convention used to adjust the underlying instrument's provision's date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the UnderlyingDateAdjustment component within the UnderlyingInstrument component.

42153.name: UnderlyingProvisionDateAdjusted
42153.description: The adjusted date of the provision.

42154.name: UnderlyingProvisionDateTenorPeriod
42154.description: Time unit multiplier for the provision's tenor period.

42155.name: UnderlyingProvisionDateTenorUnit
42155.description: Time unit associated with the provision's tenor period.

42156.name: UnderlyingProvisionCalculationAgent
42156.description: Used to identify the calculation agent. The calculation agent may be identified in UnderlyingProvisionCalculationAgent(42156) or in the underlying provision parties component.

values.meaning: As specified in the master agreement
As specified in the standard terms supplement

42157.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionSinglePartyBuyerSide
42157.description: If optional early termination is not available to both parties then this component identifies the buyer of the option through its side of the trade.

42158.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionSinglePartySellerSide
42158.description: If optional early termination is not available to both parties then this component identifies the seller of the option through its side of the trade.

42160.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseMultipleNotional
42160.description: A notional amount which restricts the amount of notional that can be exercised when partial exercise or multiple exercise is applicable. The integral multiple amount defines a lower limit of notional that can be exercised and also defines a unit multiple of notional that can be exercised, i.e. only integer multiples of this amount can be exercised.

42161.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseMinimumNotional
42161.description: The minimum notional amount that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

42162.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseMaximumNotional
42162.description: The maximum notional amount that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

42163.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionMinimumNumber
42163.description: The minimum number of options that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

42164.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionMaximumNumber
42164.description: The maximum number of options that can be exercised on a given exercise date. If the number is not specified, it means that the maximum number of options corresponds to the remaining unexercised options.

42165.name: UnderlyingProvisionOptionExerciseConfirmation
42165.description: Used to indicate whether follow-up confirmation of exercise (written or electronic) is required following telephonic notice by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent.

42166.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlMethod
42166.description: An ISDA defined cash settlement method used for the determination of the applicable cash settlement amount. The method is defined in the 2006 ISDA Definitions, Section 18.3. Cash Settlement Methods, paragraph (e).

42167.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlCurrency
42167.description: Specifies the currency of settlement. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

42168.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlCurrency2
42168.description: Specifies the currency of settlement for a cross-currency provision. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

42169.name: UnderlyingProvisionCashSettlQuoteType

42734.name: ReturnRateFXRateCalc
42734.description: Specifies whether ReturnRateFXRate(42733) should be multiplied or divided.

42735.name: NoReturnRates
42735.description: Number of iterations in the return rate repeating group.

42736.name: ReturnRatePriceSequence
42736.description: Specifies the type of price sequence of the return rate.

42737.name: ReturnRateCommissionBasis
42737.description: Specifies the basis or unit used to calculate the commission.

42739.name: ReturnRateCommissionCurrency
42739.description: Specifies the currency the commission amount is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

42741.name: ReturnRateDeterminationMethod
42741.description:
Specifies the method by which the underlier prices are determined.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

42742.name: ReturnRateAmountRelativeTo
42742.description:
Specifies the reference amount when the return rate amount is relative to another amount in the trade.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/payment-amount-relative-to for code list of relative amounts.

42743.name: ReturnRateQuoteMeasureType
42743.description:
Specifies the type of the measure applied to the return rate's asset, e.g. valuation, sensitivity risk. This could be an NPV, a cash flow, a clean price, etc.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/asset-measure for values.

42744.name: ReturnRateQuoteUnits
42744.description:
Specifies the units that the measure is expressed in. If not specified, the default is a price/value in currency units.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/price-quote-units for values.

42745.name: ReturnRateQuoteMethod
42745.description: Specifies the type of quote used to determine the return rate of the swap.

42746.name: ReturnRateQuoteCurrency
42746.description: Specifies the currency the return rate quote is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 Currency Code.

42747.name: ReturnRateQuoteCurrencyType
42747.description:
Specifies the type of currency, e.g. settlement currency, base currency, etc., that the quote is reported in.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/reporting-currency-type for values.

42748.name: ReturnRateQuoteTimeType
42748.description: Specifies how or the timing when the quote is to be obtained.

values.meaning: As specified in the master confirmation

42749.name: ReturnRateQuoteTime
42749.description: The time when the quote is to be generated.

42750.name: ReturnRateQuoteDate
42750.description: The date when the quote is to be generated.

42751.name: ReturnRateQuoteExpirationTime
42751.description: The time when the quote ceases to be valid.

42752.name: ReturnRateQuoteBusinessCenter
42752.description:
The business center calendar used for adjustments associated with ReturnRateQuoteTimeType(42748) or ReturnRateQuoteTime(42749) and ReturnRateQuoteDate(42750), e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

42753.name: ReturnRateQuoteExchange
42753.description: Specifies the exchange (e.g. stock or listed futures/options exchange) from which the quote is obtained.

42754.name: ReturnRateQuotePricingModel
42754.description:
Specifies the pricing model used to evaluate the underlying asset price.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/pricing-model for values.

42755.name: ReturnRateCashFlowType
42755.description:
Specifies the type of cash flows, e.g. coupon payment, premium fee, settlement fee, etc.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/cashflow-type for values.

42756.name: ReturnRateValuationTimeType
42756.description: Specifies the timing at which the calculation agent values the underlying.

values.meaning: As specified in the master confirmation

42757.name: ReturnRateValuationTime
42757.description: The time at which the calculation agent values the underlying asset.

42758.name: ReturnRateValuationTimeBusinessCenter
42758.description:
The business center calendar used for adjustments associated with ReturnRateValuationTimeType(42756) or ReturnRateValuationTime(42757), e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

42759.name: ReturnRateValuationPriceOption
42759.description: Indicates whether an ISDA price option applies, and if applicable which type of price.

42760.name: ReturnRateFinalPriceFallback
42760.description: Specifies the fallback provision for the hedging party in the determination of the final price.

42761.name: NoReturnRateInformationSources
42761.description: Number of iterations in the return rate information source repeating group.

42762.name: ReturnRateInformationSource
42762.description: Identifies the source of rate information. For FX the references source to be used for the FX spot rate.

42763.name: ReturnRateReferencePage
42763.description:
Identifies the reference "page" from the rate source.
For FX, the reference page to the spot rate to be used for the reference FX spot rate.
When ReturnRateInformationSource(42762) = 3 (ISDA Settlement Rate Option) this contains the value from the scheme that reflects the terms of the Annex A to the ISDA 1998 FX and Currency Option Definitions.
See: https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-rate-option

42764.name: ReturnRateReferencePageHeading
42764.description: Identifies the page heading from the rate source.

42765.name: NoReturnRatePrices
42765.description: Number of iterations in the return rate price repeating group.

42766.name: ReturnRatePriceBasis
42766.description: The basis of the return price.

42767.name: ReturnRatePrice
42767.description: Specifies the price of the underlying swap asset.

42768.name: ReturnRatePriceCurrency
42768.description: Specifies the currency of the price of the underlying swap asset. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

42769.name: ReturnRatePriceType
42769.description: Specifies whether the ReturnRatePrice(42767) is expressed in absolute or relative terms.

42770.name: NoReturnRateValuationDateBusinessCenters
42770.description: Number of iterations in the return rate valuation date business center repeating group.

42771.name: ReturnRateValuationDateBusinessCenter
42771.description:
The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the return rate valuation unadjusted or relative dates, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

42772.name: NoReturnRateValuationDates
42772.description: Number of iterations in the return rate valuation date repeating group.

42773.name: ReturnRateValuationDate
42773.description: The return rate valuation date. Type of date is specified in ReturnRateValuationDateType(42774).

42774.name: ReturnRateValuationDateType
42774.description: Specifies the type of return rate valuation date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

42775.name: NoSettlMethodElectionDateBusinessCenters
42775.description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

42776.name: SettlMethodElectionDateBusinessCenter
42776.description:
The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the settlement method election unadjusted or relative date, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

42777.name: SettlMethodElectionDateUnadjusted
42777.description: The unadjusted settlement method election date.

42778.name: SettlMethodElectionDateBusinessDayConvention
42778.description: The settlement method election date adjustment business day convention.

42779.name: SettlMethodElectionDateRelativeTo
42779.description:
Specifies the anchor date when the settlement method election date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

42780.name: SettlMethodElectionDateOffsetPeriod
42780.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative settlement method election date offset.

42781.name: SettlMethodElectionDateOffsetUnit
42781.description: Time unit associated with the relative settlement method election date offset.

42782.name: SettlMethodElectionDateOffsetDayType
42782.description: Specifies the day type of the relative settlement method election date offset.

42783.name: SettlMethodElectionDateAdjusted
42783.description: The adjusted settlement method election date.

42784.name: StreamVersion
42784.description: The stream version identifier when there have been modifications to the contract over time. Helps signal when there are embedded changes.

42785.name: StreamVersionEffectiveDate
42785.description: The effective date of the StreamVersion(42784).

42786.name: StreamNotionalDeterminationMethod
42786.description:
Specifies the method for determining the floating notional value for equity swaps.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

42787.name: StreamNotionalAdjustments
42787.description: For equity swaps this specifies the conditions that govern the adjustment to the number of units of the swap.

42788.name: NoUnderlyingCashSettlDateBusinessCenters
42788.description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

42789.name: UnderlyingCashSettlDateBusinessCenter
42789.description:
The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the cash settlement unadjusted or relative date, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

42791.name: UnderlyingCashSettlDateBusinessDayConvention
42791.description: The business day convention used to adjust the cash settlement provision's date. Used only to override the business day convention defined in the UnderlyingInstrument component.

42792.name: UnderlyingCashSettlDateRelativeTo
42792.description:
Specifies the anchor date when the cash settlement date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

42793.name: UnderlyingCashSettlDateOffsetPeriod
42793.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative cash settlement date offset.

42794.name: UnderlyingCashSettlDateOffsetUnit
42794.description: Time unit associated with the relative cash settlement date offset.

42795.name: UnderlyingCashSettlDateOffsetDayType
42795.description: Specifies the day type of the relative cash settlement date offset.

42797.name: UnderlyingCashSettlPriceSource
42797.description:
The source from which the settlement price is to be obtained.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-price-source for values.

42798.name: UnderlyingCashSettlPriceDefault
42798.description: The default election for determining settlement price.

42800.name: UnderlyingDividendAccrualPaymentDateBusinessCenter
42800.description:
The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the instrument's dividend accrual payment date, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

42801.name: UnderlyingDividendFloatingRateIndex
42801.description: The dividend accrual floating rate index.

42802.name: UnderlyingDividendFloatingRateIndexCurvePeriod
42802.description: Time unit multiplier for the dividend accrual floating rate index curve.

42803.name: UnderlyingDividendFloatingRateIndexCurveUnit
42803.description: Time unit associated with the dividend accrual floating rate index curve period.

42804.name: UnderlyingDividendFloatingRateMultiplier
42804.description: A rate multiplier to apply to the floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the contract.

42805.name: UnderlyingDividendFloatingRateSpread
42805.description: The basis points spread from the index specified in UnderlyingDividendFloatingRateIndex(42801).

42806.name: UnderlyingDividendFloatingRateSpreadPositionType
42806.description: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or short position.

42807.name: UnderlyingDividendFloatingRateTreatment
42807.description: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the index.

42808.name: UnderlyingDividendCapRate
42808.description: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. It is only required where the floating rate is capped at a certain level. The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

42809.name: UnderlyingDividendCapRateBuySide
42809.description: Reference to the buyer of the cap rate option through its trade side.

42810.name: UnderlyingDividendCapRateSellSide
42810.description: Reference to the seller of the cap rate option through its trade side.

42811.name: UnderlyingDividendFloorRate
42811.description: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate is floored at a certain strike level. The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate. The rate is expressed as a decimal, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

42812.name: UnderlyingDividendFloorRateBuySide
42812.description: Reference to the buyer of the floor rate option through its trade side.

42813.name: UnderlyingDividendFloorRateSellSide
42813.description: Reference to the seller of the floor rate option through its trade side.

42814.name: UnderlyingDividendInitialRate
42814.description: The initial floating rate reset agreed between the principal parties involved in the trade. This is assumed to be the first required reset rate for the first regular calculation period. It should only be included when the rate is not equal to the rate published on the source implied by the floating rate index. The initial rate is expressed in decimal form, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

42815.name: UnderlyingDividendFinalRateRoundingDirection
42815.description: Specifies the rounding direction of the final rate.

42816.name: UnderlyingDividendFinalRatePrecision
42816.description: Specifies the rounding precision of the final rate in terms of a number of decimal places. Note how a percentage rate rounding of 5 decimal places is expressed as a rounding precision of 7.

42817.name: UnderlyingDividendAveragingMethod
42817.description: When averaging is applicable, used to specify whether a weighted or unweighted average method of calculation is to be used.

42818.name: UnderlyingDividendNegativeRateTreatment
42818.description: The specification of any provisions for calculating payment obligations when a floating rate is negative (either due to a quoted negative floating rate or by operation of a spread that is subtracted from the floating rate).

42819.name: UnderlyingDividendAccrualPaymentDateRelativeTo
42819.description:
Specifies the anchor date when the accrual payment date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

42820.name: UnderlyingDividendAccrualPaymentDateOffsetPeriod
42820.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative accrual payment date offset.

42821.name: UnderlyingDividendAccrualPaymentDateOffsetUnit
42821.description: Time unit associated with the relative accrual payment date offset.

42822.name: UnderlyingDividendAccrualPaymentDateOffsetDayType
42822.description: Specifies the day type of the relative accrual payment date offset.

42824.name: UnderlyingDividendAccrualPaymentDateBusinessDayConvention
42824.description: Accrual payment date adjustment business day convention.

42826.name: UnderlyingDividendReinvestmentIndicator
42826.description: Indicates whether the dividend will be reinvested.

42827.name: UnderlyingDividendEntitlementEvent
42827.description: Defines the contract event which the receiver of the derivative is entitled to the dividend.

42828.name: UnderlyingDividendAmountType
42828.description: Indicates how the gross cash dividend amount per share is determined.

42829.name: UnderlyingDividendUnderlierRefID
42829.description: References the dividend underlier through the instrument's UnderlyingSecurityID(309) which must be fully specified in a separate instance of the UnderlyingInstrument component.

42830.name: UnderlyingExtraordinaryDividendPartySide
42830.description: Reference to the party through its side in the trade who makes the determination whether dividends are extraordinary in relation to normal levels.

42831.name: UnderlyingExtraordinaryDividendAmountType
42831.description: Indicates how the extraordinary gross cash dividend per share is determined.

42832.name: UnderlyingExtraordinaryDividendCurrency
42832.description: The currency in which the excess dividend is denominated. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

42833.name: UnderlyingExtraordinaryDividendDeterminationMethod
42833.description:
Specifies the method in which the excess amount is determined.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

42834.name: UnderlyingDividendAccrualFixedRate
42834.description: The dividend accrual fixed rate per annum expressed as a decimal.

42835.name: UnderlyingDividendCompoundingMethod
42835.description: The compounding method to be used when more than one dividend period contributes to a single payment.

42836.name: UnderlyingDividendNumOfIndexUnits
42836.description: The number of index units applicable to dividends.

42838.name: UnderlyingDividendCashEquivalentPercentage
42838.description: Declared cash-equivalent dividend percentage. A value of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

42839.name: UnderlyingNonCashDividendTreatment
42839.description: Defines the treatment of non-cash dividends.

42840.name: UnderlyingDividendComposition
42840.description: Defines how the composition of dividends is to be determined.

42841.name: UnderlyingSpecialDividendsIndicator
42841.description: Indicates whether special dividends are applicable.

42842.name: UnderlyingMaterialDividendsIndicator
42842.description: Indicates whether material non-cash dividends are applicable.

42843.name: UnderlyingOptionsExchangeDividendsIndicator
42843.description: Indicates whether option exchange dividends are applicable.

42844.name: UnderlyingAdditionalDividendsIndicator
42844.description: Indicates whether additional dividends are applicable.

42845.name: UnderlyingAllDividendsIndicator
42845.description: Represents the European Master Confirmation value of 'All Dividends' which, when applicable, signifies that, for a given Ex-Date, the daily observed share price for that day is adjusted (reduced) by the cash dividend and/or the cash value of any non-cash dividend per share (including extraordinary dividends) declared by the issuer.

42846.name: UnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateRelativeTo
42846.description:
Specifies the anchor date when the FX trigger date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

42847.name: UnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateOffsetPeriod
42847.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative FX trigger date offset.

42848.name: UnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateOffsetUnit
42848.description: Time unit associated with the relative FX trigger date offset.

42849.name: UnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateOffsetDayType
42849.description: Specifies the day type of the relative FX trigger date offset.

42851.name: UnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateBusinessDayConvention
42851.description: The business day convention used for the FX trigger date adjustment.

42854.name: UnderlyingDividendFXTriggerDateBusinessCenter
42854.description:
The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the instrument's FX trigger date, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

42855.name: NoUnderlyingDividendPayments
42855.description: Number of entries in the repeating group.

42856.name: UnderlyingDividendPaymentDate
42856.description: Specifies the date that the dividend or coupon payment is due.

42857.name: UnderlyingDividendPaymentAmount
42857.description: The amount of the dividend or coupon payment.

42858.name: UnderlyingDividendPaymentCurrency
42858.description: Specifies the currency the UnderlyingDividendPaymentAmount(42857) is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

42859.name: UnderlyingDividendAccruedInterest
42859.description: Accrued interest on the dividend or coupon payment.

42860.name: UnderlyingDividendPayoutRatio
42860.description: Specifies the actual dividend payout ratio associated with the equity or bond underlier.

42861.name: UnderlyingDividendPayoutConditions
42861.description: Specifies the dividend payout conditions that will be applied in the case where the actual ratio is not known, typically because of regulatory or legal uncertainties.

42862.name: NoUnderlyingDividendPeriods
42862.description: Number of entries in the UnderlyingDividendPeriodGrp component.

42863.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodSequence
42863.description: Defines the ordinal dividend period. E.g. 1 = First period, 2 = Second period, etc.

42864.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodStartDateUnadjusted
42864.description: The unadjusted date on which the dividend period will begin.

42865.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodEndDateUnadjusted
42865.description: The unadjusted date on which the dividend period will end.

42866.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodUnderlierRefID
42866.description: References the dividend underlier through the instrument's UnderlyingSecurityID(309) which must be fully specified in an instance of the UnderlyingInstrument component.

42867.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodStrikePrice
42867.description: Specifies the fixed strike price of the dividend period.

42868.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodBusinessDayConvention
42868.description: The dividend period dates business day convention.

42869.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodValuationDateUnadjusted
42869.description: The unadjusted dividend period valuation date.

42870.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodValuationDateRelativeTo
42870.description:
Specifies the anchor date when the dividend period valuation date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

42871.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodValuationDateOffsetPeriod
42871.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative dividend period valuation date offset.

42872.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodValuationDateOffsetUnit
42872.description: Time unit associated with the relative dividend period valuation date offset.

42873.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodValuationDateOffsetDayType
42873.description: Specifies the day type of the relative dividend period valuation date offset.

42874.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodValuationDateAdjusted
42874.description: The adjusted dividend period valuation date.

42875.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodPaymentDateUnadjusted
42875.description: The unadjusted dividend period payment date.

42876.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodPaymentDateRelativeTo
42876.description:
Specifies the anchor date when the dividend period payment date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

42877.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodPaymentDateOffsetPeriod
42877.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative dividend period payment date offset.

42878.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodPaymentDateOffsetUnit
42878.description: Time unit associated with the relative dividend period payment date offset.

42879.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodPaymentDateOffsetDayType
42879.description: Specifies the day type of the relative dividend period payment date offset.

42880.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodPaymentDateAdjusted
42880.description: The adjusted dividend period payment date.

42881.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodXID
42881.description: Identifier for linking this stream dividend period to an underlier through an instance of RelatedInstrumentGrp.

42883.name: UnderlyingDividendPeriodBusinessCenter
42883.description:
The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the instrument's dividend period date, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

42884.name: NoUnderlyingExtraordinaryEvents
42884.description: Number of extraordinary events in the repeating group.

42885.name: UnderlyingExtraordinaryEventType
42885.description:
Identifies the type of extraordinary or disruptive event applicable to UnderlyingExtraordinaryEventType(42885).
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/extraordinary-event-type for code list of extraordinary event types and values.

42886.name: UnderlyingExtraordinaryEventValue
42886.description:
The extraordinary or disruptive event value appropriate to UnderlyingExtraordinaryEventType(42885).
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/extraordinary-event-type for code list of extraordinary event types and values.

42887.name: UnderlyingSettlMethodElectingPartySide
42887.description: Side value of the party electing the settlement method.

42888.name: UnderlyingMakeWholeDate
42888.description: The date through which the option cannot be exercised without penalty.

42889.name: UnderlyingMakeWholeAmount
42889.description: Amount to be paid by the buyer of the option if the option is exercised prior to the UnderlyingMakeWholeDate(42888).

42890.name: UnderlyingMakeWholeBenchmarkCurveName
42890.description: Identifies the benchmark floating rate index.

42891.name: UnderlyingMakeWholeBenchmarkCurvePoint
42891.description: The point on the floating rate index curve.

42892.name: UnderlyingMakeWholeRecallSpread
42892.description: Spread over the floating rate index.

42893.name: UnderlyingMakeWholeBenchmarkQuote
42893.description: The quote side of the benchmark to be used for calculating the "make whole" amount.

42894.name: UnderlyingMakeWholeInterpolationMethod
42894.description: The method used when calculating the "make whole" amount. The most common is linear method.

42895.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCashSettlIndicator
42895.description: Indicates whether cash settlement is applicable.

42896.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingXIDRef
42896.description: Reference to the stream which details the compounding fixed or floating rate.

42897.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingSpread
42897.description: The spread to be used for compounding. Used in scenarios where the interest payment is based on a compounding formula that uses a compounding spread in addition to the regular spread.

42898.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamInterpolationMethod
42898.description: The method used when calculating the index rate from multiple points on the curve. The most common is linear method.

42900.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingFixedRate
42900.description: The compounding fixed rate applicable to the payment stream.

42901.name: NoUnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDates
42901.description: Number of dates in the repeating group.

42902.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDate
42902.description: The compounding date. Type of date is specified in UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDateType(42903).

42903.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDateType
42903.description: Specifies the type of payment compounding date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

42904.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesBusinessDayConvention
42904.description: The compounding dates business day convention.

42905.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesRelativeTo
42905.description:
Specifies the anchor date when the compounding dates are relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

42906.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesOffsetPeriod
42906.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative compounding date offset.

42907.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesOffsetUnit
42907.description: Time unit associated with the relative compounding date offset.

42908.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesOffsetDayType
42908.description: Specifies the day type of the relative compounding date offset.

42909.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingPeriodSkip
42909.description: The number of periods in the "RelativeTo" schedule that are between each date in the compounding schedule. A skip of 2 would mean that compounding dates are relative to every second date in the "RelativeTo" schedule. If present this should have a value greater than 1.

42910.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingFrequencyPeriod
42910.description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency at which compounding dates occur.

42911.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingFrequencyUnit
42911.description: Time unit associated with the frequency at which compounding dates occur.

42912.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingRollConvention
42912.description: The convention for determining the sequence of compounding dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency.

42913.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamBoundsFirstDateUnadjusted

42914.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamBoundsLastDateUnadjusted

42915.name: NoUnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesBusinessCenters

42916.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingDatesBusinessCenter
42916.description:
The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the payment stream compounding dates, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

42918.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateRelativeTo
42918.description:
Specifies the anchor date when the compounding end date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

42919.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateOffsetPeriod
42919.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative compounding end date offset.

42920.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateOffsetUnit
42920.description: Time unit associated with the relative compounding end date offset.

42921.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingEndDateOffsetDayType
42921.description: Specifies the day type of the relative compounding end date offset.

42923.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndex
42923.description: The payment stream's compounding floating rate index.

42924.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndexCurvePeriod
42924.description: Time unit multiplier for the payment stream's compounding floating rate index curve period.

42925.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndexCurveUnit
42925.description: Time unit associated with the payment stream's compounding floating rate index curve period.

42926.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingRateMultiplier
42926.description: A rate multiplier to apply to the compounding floating rate. The multiplier can be less than or greater than 1 (one). This should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

42927.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingRateSpread
42927.description: The basis points spread from the index specified in UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingRateIndex(42923).

42928.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingRateSpreadPositionType
42928.description: Identifies whether the rate spread is applied to a long or short position.

42929.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingRateTreatment
42929.description: Specifies the yield calculation treatment for the index.

42930.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingCapRate
42930.description: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the compounding floating rate. It is only required where the compounding floating rate on a swap stream is capped at a certain level. The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

42931.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingCapRateBuySide
42931.description: Reference to the buyer of the compounding cap rate option through its trade side.

42932.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingCapRateSellSide
42932.description: Reference to the seller of the compounding cap rate option through its trade side.

42933.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingFloorRate
42933.description: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the compounding floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the compounding floating rate on a swap stream is floored at a certain strike level. The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate. The rate is expressed as a decimal, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

42934.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingFloorRateBuySide
42934.description: Reference to the buyer of the compounding floor rate option through its trade side.

42935.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingFloorRateSellSide
42935.description: Reference to the seller of the floor rate option through its trade side.

42936.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingInitialRate
42936.description: The initial compounding floating rate reset agreed between the principal parties involved in the trade. It should only be included when the rate is not equal to the rate published on the source implied by the floating rate index. The initial rate is expressed in decimal form, e.g. 5% is represented as "0.05".

42937.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingFinalRateRoundingDirection
42937.description: Specifies the rounding direction for the compounding floating rate.

42938.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingFinalRatePrecision
42938.description: Specifies the compounding floating rate rounding precision in terms of a number of decimal places. Note how a percentage rate rounding of 5 decimal places is expressed as a rounding precision of 7.

42939.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingAveragingMethod
42939.description: Specifies the averaging method when compounding floating rate averaging is applicable (e.g. weighted or unweighted).

42940.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingNegativeRateTreatment
42940.description: Specifies the method for calculating payment obligations when a compounding floating rate is negative (either due to a quoted negative floating rate or by operation of a spread that is subtracted from the floating rate).

42942.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateRelativeTo
42942.description:
Specifies the anchor date when the compounding start date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

42943.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateOffsetPeriod
42943.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative compounding start date offset.

42944.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateOffsetUnit
42944.description: Time unit associated with the relative compounding start date offset.

42945.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamCompoundingStartDateOffsetDayType
42945.description: Specifies the day type of the relative compounding start date offset.

42947.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFormulaImageLength
42947.description: Length in bytes of the UnderlyingPaymentStreamFormulaImage(42948) field.

42948.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFormulaImage
42948.description: Image of the formula image when represented through an encoded clip in base64Binary.

42949.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateUnadjusted
42949.description: The unadjusted final price payment date.

42950.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateRelativeTo
42950.description:
Specifies the anchor date when the final price payment date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

42951.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateOffsetPeriod
42951.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative final price payment date offset.

42952.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateOffsetUnit
42952.description: Time unit associated with the relative final price payment date offset.

42953.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateOffsetDayType
42953.description: Specifies the day type of the relative final price payment date offset.

42954.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFinalPricePaymentDateAdjusted
42954.description: The adjusted final price payment date.

42955.name: NoUnderlyingPaymentStreamFixingDates
42955.description: Number of fixing dates in the repeating group.

42956.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFixingDate
42956.description: The fixing date. Type of date is specified in UnderlyingPaymentStreamFixingDateType(42957).

42957.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFixingDateType
42957.description: Specifies the type of fixing date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

42958.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFirstObservationDateUnadjusted
42958.description: The unadjusted initial price observation date.

42959.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFirstObservationDateRelativeTo
42959.description:
Specifies the anchor date when the initial price observation date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

42960.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFirstObservationDateOffsetDayType
42960.description: Specifies the day type of the initial price observation date offset.

42961.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFirstObservationDateAdjusted
42961.description: The adjusted initial price observation date.

42962.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamUnderlierRefID
42962.description: References the dividend underlier through the instrument's UnderlyingSecurityID(309) which must be fully specified in an instance of the UnderlyingInstrument component.

42963.name: UnderlyingReturnRateNotionalReset
42963.description: Indicates whether the term "Equity Notional Reset" as defined in the ISDA 2002 Equity Derivatives Definitions is applicable ("Y") or not.

42964.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamLinkInitialLevel
42964.description: Price level at which the correlation or variance swap contract will strike.

42965.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamLinkClosingLevelIndicator
42965.description: Indicates whether the correlation or variance swap contract will ("Y") strike off the closing level of the default exchange traded contract or not.

42966.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamLinkExpiringLevelIndicator
42966.description: Indicates whether the correlation or variance swap contract will ("Y") strike off the expiring level of the default exchange traded contract or not.

42967.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamLinkEstimatedTradingDays
42967.description: The expected number of trading days in the variance or correlation swap stream.

42968.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamLinkStrikePrice
42968.description: The strike price of a correlation or variance swap stream.

42969.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamLinkStrikePriceType
42969.description: For a variance swap specifies how UnderlyingPaymentStreamLinkStrikePrice(42968) is expressed.

42970.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamLinkMaximumBoundary
42970.description: Specifies the maximum or upper boundary for variance or strike determination.

42971.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamLinkMinimumBoundary
42971.description: Specifies the minimum or lower boundary for variance or strike determination.

42972.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamLinkNumberOfDataSeries
42972.description: Number of data series for a correlation swap. Normal market practice is that correlation data sets are drawn from geographic market areas, such as America, Europe and Asia Pacific. Each of these geographic areas will have its own data series to avoid contagion.

42973.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamVarianceUnadjustedCap
42973.description: Indicates the scaling factor to be multiplied by the variance strike price thereby making variance cap applicable.

42974.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRealizedVarianceMethod
42974.description: Indicates which price to use to satisfy the boundary condition.

42975.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamDaysAdjustmentIndicator
42975.description: Indicates whether the contract specifies that the notional should be scaled by the number of days in range divided by the estimate trading days or not. The number of "days in range" refers to the number of returns that contribute to the realized volatility.

42976.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamNearestExchangeContractRefID
42976.description: References a contract listed on an exchange through the instrument's UnderlyingSecurityID(309) which must be fully specified in an instance of the UnderlyingInstrument component.

42977.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamVegaNotionalAmount
42977.description: Vega Notional represents the approximate gain/loss at maturity for a 1% difference between RVol (realised volatility) and KVol (strike volatility). It does not necessarily represent the Vega risk of the trade.

42978.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFormulaCurrency
42978.description: The currency in which the formula amount is denominated. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

42979.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFormulaCurrencyDeterminationMethod
42979.description:
Specifies the method according to which the formula amount currency is determined.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

42980.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFormulaReferenceAmount
42980.description:
Specifies the reference amount when this term either corresponds to the standard ISDA Definition (either the 2002 Equity Definition for the Equity Amount, or the 2000 Definition for the Interest Amount), or refers to a term defined elsewhere in the swap document.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/payment-amount-relative-to for code list of reference amounts.

42981.name: NoUnderlyingPaymentStreamFormulas
42981.description: Number of formulas in the repeating group.

42982.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFormula
42982.description: Contains an XML representation of the formula. Defined for flexibility in choice of language (MathML, OpenMath or text).

42983.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFormulaDesc
42983.description: A description of the math formula in UnderlyingPaymentStreamFormula(42982).

42985.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubEndDateBusinessDayConvention
42985.description: The stub end date business day convention.

42986.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubEndDateRelativeTo
42986.description:
Specifies the anchor date when the stub end date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

42987.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubEndDateOffsetPeriod
42987.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative stub end date offset.

42988.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubEndDateOffsetUnit
42988.description: Time unit associated with the relative stub end date offset.

42989.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubEndDateOffsetDayType
42989.description: Specifies the day type of the relative stub end date offset.

42991.name: NoUnderlyingPaymentStubEndDateBusinessCenters
42991.description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

42992.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubEndDateBusinessCenter
42992.description:
The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the payment stub end date, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

42994.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubStartDateBusinessDayConvention
42994.description: The stub start date business day convention.

42995.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubStartDateRelativeTo
42995.description:
Specifies the anchor date when the stub start date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

42996.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubStartDateOffsetPeriod
42996.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative stub start date offset.

42997.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubStartDateOffsetUnit
42997.description: Time unit associated with the relative stub start date offset.

42998.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubStartDateOffsetDayType
42998.description: Specifies the day type of the relative stub start date offset.
